label: Motorola MB7621 24x8 DOCSIS 3.0 cable modem
description: DOCSIS 3.0 cable modem with 24 bonded downstream and 8 bonded upstream channels and exactly one Gigabit Ethernet port; no Wi-Fi, no telephone jacks.
notes: Datasheet: 24x8 DOCSIS 3.0, 1029/246 Mbps nominal DS/US, 'Gigabit Ethernet port for a high-speed plug-in connection to a router, computer, or other Internet-capable device'. Explicitly 'does not have a built-in wireless router and does not have telephone jacks', so the port list is one F-connector and one RJ45.
